name: Export Customers Data
author: Fahad Mahmood

sections.description:
A helper plugin for WooCommerce that exports customer data with full flexibility. Email lists, order history, customer lifetime value, or any other detail: you choose what to export, and how.

Features:
* Export customers in CSV or XLSX format
* Include custom user meta fields
* Support for WooCommerce Analytics fields like total_spend, orders_count, etc.
* Smart field mapping (like phone, address, name)
* Filters: date range, country, payment method, user role, minimum orders and spend
* Built-in support for special fields not available in user meta
* AJAX-based chunk exports that work on large stores, with a cancel button
* HPOS (custom order tables) compatible

Security:
* Export files are stored in a protected folder and downloaded only through a permission and nonce checked link, then deleted
* Credentials and tokens in user meta are never exported
* CSV cells are protected against spreadsheet formula injection

Pro (optional add-on):
* Scheduled exports: automatically email a customers CSV daily, weekly or monthly with your chosen fields and filters

Author: Fahad Mahmood
Project URI: https://androidbubble.com/blog/wordpress/plugins/export-customers-data
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install through the Plugins menu.
  2. Activate it via the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Export Customers to begin exporting.
sections.faq:
How to export customer data?

Go to WooCommerce → Export Customers, select the fields and filters you want, and click Export.

Can I export custom meta fields?

Yes. The plugin detects and includes user meta fields. Keys that look like passwords, tokens or secrets are always excluded.

Is `total_spend` and `orders_count` available?

Yes. These are pulled from WooCommerce Analytics and can be selected as export fields.

What format is the export in?

Both CSV and XLSX formats are supported.

Who can export?

Users with the manage_woocommerce capability (administrators and shop managers).

How does Pro work?

Pro is plug and play: if the plugin’s pro folder is present, Pro features switch on automatically. Without it, all free features keep working.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Security: export files moved to a protected folder and served through an authenticated, nonce-checked download
  • Security: fixed reflected XSS in the admin head script and escaped all admin output
  • Security: capability checks on every export entry point; sensitive meta keys excluded; CSV formula injection protection
  • Fix: XLSX chunk export now works (it was a placeholder)
  • Fix: User Role and Payment Method filters now apply
  • Fix: plugin no longer loads admin-only code on every front-end request
  • New: HPOS compatibility declaration, “Requires Plugins: woocommerce”
  • New: Pro scheduled email exports (plug and play via the pro folder)
  • Removed an unused external Font Awesome request; text domain now matches the plugin slug
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1

1.2.7

  • Fix: Fields export revised. [07/03/2026]

1.2.6

  • New: Smart field mapping (phone, address, etc.)
  • New: Support for WooCommerce Analytics fields (total_spend, orders_count, etc.)
  • New: Advanced filter system (by country, order date, payment method, and more)
  • Improved: Export UX and chunk-based performance for large data

1.2.5

  • Minor fixes and improvements
